resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Nynorsk source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, partial and complete builds, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: An independent whole-locale pass identified 25 actionable Nynorsk translation defects in the remaining Kirchhoff and opening TCR text; all 25 were corrected in this bounded iteration.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Nynorsk human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff description retained Bokmål vocabulary and an unclear compound.
evidence: Before: beskriver bevaring i kretsknutepunkter og lukkede sløyfer.
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk wording describing conservation at circuit nodes and in closed loops.

findings.summary: The loop definition was entirely Bokmål.
evidence: Before: En sløyfe er en lukket vei som kommer tilbake til utgangspunktet.
findings.resolution: Changed to: Ei sløyfe er ein lukka veg som kjem tilbake til utgangspunktet.

findings.summary: The series-connection definition used Bokmål forms.
evidence: Before: En seriekobling gir strømmen berre én vei gjennom komponentene.
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk seriekopling, straum, éin, veg, and komponentane forms.

findings.summary: The parallel-connection definition used Bokmål forms.
evidence: Before: En parallellkobling kobler grener til de samme to nodene.
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk parallellkopling, koplar, greinene, dei same, and nodane forms.

findings.summary: The current-law example retained Bokmål articles, verbs, and electrical terms.
evidence: Before: går inn i en node ... én gren ... de resterende grenene ... når du regner.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the example with Nynorsk articles, terminology, and verb forms.

findings.summary: The section title used the Bokmål form kretser.
evidence: Before: Serie- og parallellkretser.
findings.resolution: Changed to: Serie- og parallellkrinsar.

findings.summary: The series-resistor example title used Bokmål compounds.
evidence: Before: Seriekoblede motstander.
findings.resolution: Changed to: Seriekopla motstandar.

findings.summary: The series-resistor setup used Bokmål infinitive and noun forms.
evidence: Before: To motstander ... kobles til 8,0 V.
findings.resolution: Changed to: To motstandar ... blir kopla i serie til 8,0 V.

findings.summary: The series-resistor conclusion used Bokmål adjective and noun forms.
evidence: Before: Den samme strømmen ... begge motstandene.
findings.resolution: Changed to: Den same straumen ... begge motstandane.

findings.summary: The parallel-resistor example title used Bokmål compounds.
evidence: Before: Parallellkoblede motstander.
findings.resolution: Changed to: Parallellkopla motstandar.

findings.summary: The parallel-resistor setup used Bokmål noun and verb forms.
evidence: Before: To like grener ... kobles til 4,0 V.
findings.resolution: Changed to: To like greiner ... blir kopla til 4,0 V.

findings.summary: The parallel-resistor conclusion used Bokmål definite forms.
evidence: Before: Når grenmotstandene er like, fører hver gren 10 A.
findings.resolution: Changed to: Når greinmotstandane er like, fører kvar grein 10 A.

findings.summary: The voltage-law explanation retained several Bokmål forms.
evidence: Before: spenningsøkninger ... en lukket sløyfe ... hold polaritetene ... løsningen.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph with Nynorsk terms while preserving the polarity and voltage-drop meaning.

findings.summary: The series-cell explanation used Bokmål verb and noun forms.
evidence: Before: Seriekoblede celler legger sammen spenningen ... tilsvarer én lik celle.
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk seriekopla, legg, medan, and tilsvarande forms.

findings.summary: The parallel-cell explanation used Bokmål verb and noun forms.
evidence: Before: Parallellkoblede celler beholder samme spenning ... tilgjengelig straum.
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk parallellkopla, held på, tilgjengeleg, and om lag forms.

findings.summary: The current-sharing explanation retained Bokmål forms for dependence and wiring.
evidence: Before: Strømfordelingen avhenger av indre motstand, kontakter, ledninger og brytere.
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk straumfordelinga, avheng, kontaktar, leidningar, and brytarar.

findings.summary: The lithium-ion safety explanation used Bokmål requirements and protection terminology.
evidence: Before: Seriekoblede litiumioneceller krever overvåking ... beskyttelse.
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk seriekopla, krev, overvaking, and vern forms.

findings.summary: The practical-solving title used Bokmål forms for solving and real circuits.
evidence: Before: Løsning av virkelige kretser.
findings.resolution: Changed to: Løysing av verkelege krinsar.

findings.summary: The node-voltage bullet used Bokmål definite forms.
evidence: Before: Merk nodenes spenninger, grenstrømmer og antatte strømretninger.
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk node, greinstraum, and straumretning forms.

findings.summary: The KCL/KVL bullet used Bokmål plural forms.
evidence: Before: Bruk KCL i uavhengige noder og KVL rundt uavhengige sløyfer.
findings.resolution: Changed noder to the Nynorsk form nodar.

findings.summary: The resistor relation bullet used the Bokmål definite noun form.
evidence: Before: Knytt spenning og straum i motstander sammen ...
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk motstandar and saman forms.

findings.summary: The simultaneous-equations bullet used the Bokmål verb and noun.
evidence: Before: Løs de samtidige ligningene og kontroller effektbalansen.
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk Løys and likningane forms.

findings.summary: The circuit-model limitations paragraph was largely Bokmål and used awkward translated terminology.
evidence: Before: En forenklet modell ... virkningsgrad ... beskyttelseskretser ... sterkstrømskrets.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph with Nynorsk terms for model limits, efficiency, protection circuits, and high current.

findings.summary: The TCR description retained Bokmål forms for describing a conductor's resistance.
evidence: Before: beskriver hvordan en leders motstand endrer seg med temperaturen.
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk skildrar, korleis, ein leiar, and endrar forms.

findings.summary: The TCR linear-model introduction retained Bokmål articles and verb forms.
evidence: Before: Ved en liten eller moderat temperaturendring bruker vi dette førsteordensforholdet:
findings.resolution: Changed to: Ved ei lita eller moderat temperaturendring brukar vi dette førsteordensforholdet:
